title: Use charts to highlight important dataset information

statement.en: Use a chart when its visual prominence helps highlight important information in a dataset.
statement.ja: visual prominenceがdatasetのimportant informationを強調する場合にchartを使う。

conditions: Clearly communicate what people can learn from the data they care about.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Charting data experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるCharting dataの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Keep charts simple and reveal details on demand

statement.en: Keep a chart simple and let people reveal additional data or functionality when they want it.
statement.ja: chartをsimpleに保ち、追加dataやfunctionalityを必要時に表示できるようにする。

conditions: Avoid packing in data that obscures relationships or overwhelms the chart.
Offer levels of detail or data subsets that match people's interests.
For complex interactive charts, consider progressively introducing more capable versions.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Charting data experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるCharting dataの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

conditions: Provide accessibility labels that describe chart values and components.

title: Size charts for their function and detail

title: Keep related charts visually consistent

statement.ja: 同様の目的を持つchartは、differenceの強調が必要な場合を除きvisualに一貫させる。

conditions: Use consistent chart types and styles so learning transfers between charts.
Consider a different type or style only to highlight a meaningful difference.
